title: Hawara labyrinth and the 2008 Mataha expedition GPR scan

tellings.quote: There was an expedition, I think it was 2008 called the Mataha expedition. They GPR scanned it. They found that there's a huge slab, limestone slab, that's actually not the floor, but actually the roof of this underground chamber system.

plain: Under Hawara in Egypt, home of a famous ancient building called the labyrinth, lies a hidden system of underground rooms, according to a researcher named Geoffrey Drumm. He says a 2008 survey he calls the Mataha expedition, linked to a researcher named Ben van Kerkwijk, scanned the site with ground-penetrating radar, a tool that sees below the surface. Drumm says they found "a huge slab, limestone slab" that is "not the floor, but actually the roof of this underground chamber system", which would mean much of the site is still unexcavated.
